subject: Social Media
title: Variable Rewards
description: Learn Variable Rewards in one minute.

hook.text: Pull to refresh. Sometimes there's something great. Sometimes nothing. You pull again anyway. Sound familiar?

buildup.text: B.F. Skinner found that pigeons peck more when rewards are random. Predictable rewards bore the brain.

discovery.text: Social media uses the same trick. Likes, comments, and new posts arrive unpredictably—a digital slot machine.

twist.text: Nir Eyal's 'Hooked' model shows four steps: trigger, action, variable reward, investment. Apps follow it exactly.

climax.text: Variable rewards release dopamine not from pleasure but from anticipation. The wanting outweighs the getting.

punchline.text: You don't scroll for what you find. You scroll for what you might.

quiz.question: Why do variable rewards keep users engaged?
